title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode5 Introductions

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Backstage

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
It's nice to meet you too, uh...
Ms. Kuno...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Call me Sumire.
Again, Shiho, it's great to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: And thank you very much for coming to see our show, Mr. Hinomori. We promise to put on a good performance, so I hope you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I am.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Still, Shiho, everyone's right.
You really are adorable.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're all exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Is this the “group of ladies” that Dad said he wanted me to meet...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (They don't really seem all that amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Mr. Hinomori?
The manager's calling. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Be right over.
Shiho, can you handle yourself here for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'll keep her company while she waits for you to come back.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Alright, you guys start checking over the equipment. I'm gonna keep talking with Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line:
What?! No fair, Sumire!
You owe us a big one for this!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Anyway, let's chat!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I've actually been wanting to meet and talk with you for a little while now, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Your dad kept telling us how his youngest liked to go see shows with him.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I've been wondering what you're like because I heard you always seem to get all anxious and excited whenever you set foot inside a live house...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Dad told you that...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
He did.
Also, I'm a huge fan of your dad's work.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I saw him perform at this show I happened to go to on a whim, and I was totally blown away...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: That was when I decided to ask my friends to form a band with me.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, but... Dad's a guitarist.
How'd you become a bassist?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Haha... I did try picking up a guitar in the beginning, but one of my friends already knew how to play when we first started our band. So, I ended up on the bass.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
I know it's not the best reason...
But I really love what I do now.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Well, there's a few reasons...
But the most important one probably has to do with how the bass is key to controlling a band's rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: If the bassist can't get a good groove going, then the crowd isn't gonna respond the way you want. So, I like how my performance directly affects how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Aside from that, I have to say the sounds it produces.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: The sounds?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Yeah, because basses produce this sound that really resonates in your gut. I love how it has this ability to build up energy and excitement inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: And it feels so good while I'm playing my bass. Whenever we perform, it feels like an extension of my own body.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Then, you must really love playing the bass.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
I do!
Do you play any instruments, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Dad lets me play his guitars sometimes, but I've never played an electric bass before.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Really? Then, wanna try playing mine?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I'll lend you my bass, so why don't you try getting a feel for it.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Yeah. Here, it's a little big...
But you should be fine as long as you use the strap.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Oof...
I-It's so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(And big...
It's so different from a guitar...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: O-O-Oh no! Are you okay? Sorry for letting go of it so suddenly. I know it's really heavy...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm okay...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Just gimme a second to adjust the strap...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: A bit shorter and... Perfect!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Yeah, it suits you really well!
You look like you're in a band already!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?
I doubt you're gonna see anyone like me playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Nonsense!
Anyone with an instrument can start playing in a band the very same day!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Next, why don't you try playing it?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (The strings are so much thicker than the ones on a guitar... Am I gonna be able to get a sound out of them...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Oh, it sounds like you went a little too hard there. If the strings don't come off your fingers just right, they end up producing a bit of an ugly noise.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: How should I play it...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
So, try to relax a little more this time.
Let your fingers roll off the strings... Maybe just maintain the image of bringing them a little closer to the body.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's so low and heavy...
This sound's resonating throughout my whole body...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (This is what a bass really sounds like...?)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: That's great, Shiho. You're so talented.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Please don't treat me like a little kid...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: So, can you teach me some more...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I wanna learn how to play better.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, I'll teach you how...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Good. It's okay to take it slow since you're just starting out. Keep strumming alternately between your middle and index fingers, and speed things up when you feel you've got the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Yes! You're doing great!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: For your left hand, keep your fingers pressed down right next to the fret. That should allow you to produce nice, clean sounds with ease.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (My left hand...can't reach it...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Yeah, electric basses are pretty big...
But you might be able to reach if you tilt it up a little. Why don't you give that a try?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I got it...
I'll try playing like this.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Sure, give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Okay, if you move your fingers in the order I just showed you, then you should be able to play this riff now. Give it a try for me.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Press down next to each fret with my left hand...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Try not to yank the strings.
Just let them roll off your fingers.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (And move your fingers in the order she just showed you. Then, you should be able to play that...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I know! That was perfect!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, Shiho, your focus is so impressive.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Everyone's been making so much noise while getting ready for the show, but you basically blocked all that out.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Yeah, come to think of it...
I became so focused on getting this bass to produce the sounds I want that I ended up ignoring everything else that was happening.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (The way time flies while concentrating on accomplishing one thing...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I really like it...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, this is like...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (That time...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
I know!
Shiho, why don't you take this opportunity to start playing the bass?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
The way you played just now...
You looked like you really enjoyed it. I'm sure you'd have even more fun if you took it up seriously!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that was fun...
I wanna play some more...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (But is it okay for me to...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (When I was playing her bass just now, it felt the same as what happened then.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I got so caught up in what I was doing that I couldn't see anything else that was going on.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Which means the same thing might happen again.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
Right...
But she promised ages ago that she'd come. Shouldn't this party take priority?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But if it didn't sound like she was gonna budge...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I made things so awkward for them...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Oh, we still have some time, so why not...?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: That was enough for me.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me play your bass.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I don't wanna play anymore.
